encounters.cc: Enrollment visit for randomized controlled trial of new antihypertensive medication

lines: Enrollment visit for randomized controlled trial of new antihypertensive medication
- Acetaminophen 500 mg PO PRN for joint pain
- Mother: osteoporosis with hip fracture at age 78
Smoking: Former smoker, quit 15 years ago (12 pack-year history).
Occupation: Part-time administrative assistant (currently on medical leave).
The study aims to detect a reduction in mean systolic blood pressure of at least 10 mmHg compared to placebo.
Investigators pre-specify an alpha (α) level of 0.05 before the study begins.
After enrolling 40 patients in each group, the study finds no statistically significant difference between the new drug and placebo, with a p-value of 0.13.
The researchers note that the calculated power of the study is 65% to detect the pre-specified difference.
They discuss the implications of their findings and consider increasing the sample size in a future trial.
